items.problem: Storage section in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md only lists LocalSettings and LocalFolder, omitting other ApplicationData members that work unchanged in packaged WinUI 3
items.evidence: skill-coverage-gaps.json item 1; dev agent used ClearAsync/SetVersionAsync directly with no issues but the skill didn't confirm this was safe
items.root_cause: Incomplete API surface documentation in the Storage anchor — only two of many ApplicationData members were listed
